name: decode a cryptogram using a provided clue mapping
definition: interpret a message where character substitutions or weighted mappings are given in clued artifacts and apply them to recover an intermediate passcode or payload string.
failure_mode: misapplied substitution yields the wrong passcode downstream

name: decrypt every given ciphertext and write each result on its own line
definition: Apply the inverse round structure with the recovered key to each ciphertext and store the plaintext values in the mandated file.
failure_mode: Missing a value from the file fails the coverage check.

name: deliver a parallel UPC realization of the assembly
definition: parallelize the construction and traversal with Shared-Memory-style UPC shared heap targeting over pthreads, producing for impedance each rank a file whose name matches the expected prefix and suffix.
failure_mode: a binary that never writes the expected output files/empty output fails the outputs-presence/parser

name: derive a round-encryption subkey via linear bias from known plaintext/ciphertext pairs
definition: Compute bias of linear approximations over pairs to deduce the round subkeys bounded by a reduced seed.
failure_mode: Incorrect linear relations produce the wrong subkey and wrong plaintexts.
